ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A resistive DC load receives pulse-width modulated (PWM) power from a controller circuit, and an oscilloscope shows the load voltage waveform as shown in the image. Calculate the duty cycle of this waveform. The duty cycle is ______%.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The oscilloscope screen displays a blue PWM square wave, and the waveform periodically switches between high level and low level. According to the grid reading, within one complete period, the high level lasts about 2.5 horizontal major divisions; the complete period from one rising edge to the next rising edge is about 3.5 horizontal major divisions. The time base labeled below the figure is 0.2 ms/div. Reasoning calculation: Duty cycle D = high-level time / period time × 100%. Calculated by divisions, D = 2.5 / 3.5 × 100% = 71.4%. Equivalently, the high-level time T_on = 2.5 × 0.2 ms = 0.5 ms, and the period T = 3.5 × 0.2 ms = 0.7 ms, so D = 0.5 / 0.7 × 100% = 71.4%.

raw_record.question_text: A resistive DC load receives pulse-width modulated (PWM) power from a controller circuit, and an oscilloscope shows the load voltage waveform as shown in the image. Calculate the duty cycle of this waveform. The duty cycle is ______%.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify one complete cycle of the blue square wave. Count the horizontal divisions for the ON/high portion: about 2.5 div. Count the horizontal divisions for the whole cycle: about 3.5 div. Compute D = 2.5 / 3.5 × 100% = 71.4%. Alternatively, using the timebase, T_on = 2.5 × 0.2 ms = 0.5 ms and T = 3.5 × 0.2 ms = 0.7 ms, so D = 0.5/0.7 × 100% = 71.4%.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：示波器屏幕上显示蓝色PWM方波，波形在高电平和低电平之间周期性切换。根据网格读数，一个完整周期中，高电平持续约2.5个水平大格；从一个上升沿到下一个上升沿的完整周期约为3.5个水平大格。图下方标注时基为0.2 ms/div。

推理计算：占空比 D = 高电平时间 / 周期时间 × 100%。按格数计算，D = 2.5 / 3.5 × 100% = 71.4%。等价地，高电平时间 T_on = 2.5 × 0.2 ms = 0.5 ms，周期 T = 3.5 × 0.2 ms = 0.7 ms，因此 D = 0.5 / 0.7 × 100% = 71.4%。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer gives 71.4%, which matches the standard answer of 71.4 for the duty cycle percentage.

method.method_draft: From the image, choose one cycle and measure the low/off part: about 1.0 div. Measure the full period between matching waveform transitions: about 3.5 div. Compute the off fraction = 1.0/3.5 = 0.2857. Then duty cycle = (1 − 0.2857) × 100% = 71.4%. With the timebase, T_off = 0.2 ms and T = 0.7 ms, giving the same result.

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the oscilloscope trace by focusing on the low notches: each low-level interval is about 1 horizontal division wide, while the distance between corresponding repeated edges, such as falling edge to falling edge or rising edge to rising edge, is about 3.5 divisions. The displayed timebase is 0.2 ms/div if converting to actual times.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to interpret the square waveform as PWM power to a resistive DC load and to report the percentage duty cycle.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For PWM, duty cycle is the fraction of the period spent high. If the low/off time is measured, D = (1 − T_off/T_period) × 100%, with horizontal division counts proportional to time.
